mapper.sql: SELECT r.return_id, r.return_no, r.issue_id, r.work_order_id, r.work_order_no, r.material_id, r.material_code, r.material_name, r.spec_model, r.unit, r.return_qty, r.return_reason, r.return_time, r.return_by, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, i.issue_no AS issue_no, sub.detail_count, sub.material_codes, sub.material_names FROM mms_return_material r LEFT JOIN mms_issue i ON r.issue_id = i.issue_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT return_id, COUNT(*) AS detail_count, GROUP_CONCAT(material_code ORDER BY seq SEPARATOR ',') AS material_codes, GROUP_CONCAT(material_name ORDER BY seq SEPARATOR ',') AS material_names FROM mms_return_detail WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY return_id ) sub ON r.return_id = sub.return_id
mapper.select: SELECT r.return_id, r.return_no, r.issue_id, r.work_order_id, r.work_order_no, r.material_id, r.material_code, r.material_name, r.spec_model, r.unit, r.return_qty, r.return_reason, r.return_time, r.return_by, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, i.issue_no, wo.product_code, wo.product_name, d.detail_id AS d_detail_id, d.return_id AS d_return_id, d.seq AS d_seq, d.material_id AS d_material_id, d.material_code AS d_material_code, d.material_name AS d_material_name, d.spec_model AS d_spec_model, d.unit AS d_unit, d.return_qty AS d_return_qty, d.issue_qty AS d_issue_qty, d.del_flag AS d_del_flag, d.create_by AS d_create_by, d.create_time AS d_create_time, d.remark AS d_remark FROM mms_return_material r LEFT JOIN mms_issue i ON r.issue_id = i.issue_id LEFT JOIN mms_work_order wo ON r.work_order_id = wo.work_order_id LEFT JOIN mms_return_detail d ON r.return_id = d.return_id AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE r.return_id = #{returnId} AND r.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY d.seq ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mms_return_material ( return_no, issue_id, work_order_id, work_order_no, material_id, material_code, material_name, spec_model, unit, return_qty, return_reason, return_time, return_by, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark )VALUES( #{returnNo}, #{issueId}, #{workOrderId}, #{workOrderNo}, #{materialId}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{specModel}, #{unit}, #{returnQty}, #{returnReason}, #{returnTime}, #{returnBy}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE mms_return_material SET return_no = #{returnNo}, issue_id = #{issueId}, work_order_id = #{workOrderId}, work_order_no = #{workOrderNo}, material_id = #{materialId}, material_code = #{materialCode}, material_name = #{materialName}, spec_model = #{specModel}, unit = #{unit}, return_qty = #{returnQty}, return_reason = #{returnReason}, return_time = #{returnTime}, return_by = #{returnBy}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime}, remark = #{remark} WHERE return_id = #{returnId}

mapper.select: SELECT rd.material_code AS material_code, COALESCE(rd.return_qty, 0) AS return_qty FROM mms_return_detail rd INNER JOIN mms_return_material rm ON rd.return_id = rm.return_id WHERE rm.issue_id = #{issueId} AND rm.del_flag = '0' AND rd.del_flag = '0' AND rm.status = '1'

SELECT d.detail_id, d.return_id, d.seq, d.material_id, d.material_code, d.material_name, d.spec_model, d.unit, d.return_qty, r.return_no, i.issue_no, r.work_order_no, r.return_time, r.return_by, r.status, r.create_time FROM mms_return_detail d INNER JOIN mms_return_material r ON d.return_id = r.return_id AND r.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN mms_issue i ON r.issue_id = i.issue_id WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND r.work_order_no = #{workOrderNo} ORDER BY r.return_id DESC, d.seq ASC
